scenarios.name: ready-issue
scenarios.title: Refuse a young driver whose licence was suspended
scenarios.body:
As an underwriter reviewing a quote for a driver under 25, I want a suspended licence in the last 3 years to refuse eligibility with the reason "licence suspended", so that I do not issue a policy the PRD forbids.

Examples:
1. Inès, 24, licence suspended in March 2024 → refused, reason "licence suspended".
2. Hugo, 19, no suspension, licence since 2025 → not refused for this rule.
3. Léa, 22, suspended in 2021 → not refused for this rule (older than 3 years).

Acceptance criteria:
- Given Inès, 24, licence suspended in March 2024, when she requests eligibility, then she is refused with the reason "licence suspended".
- Given Hugo, 19, never suspended, when he requests eligibility, then this rule does not refuse him.
- Given Léa, 22, suspended in 2021, when she requests eligibility, then this rule does not refuse her.

Technical notes: rule lives in the eligibility check. Dependencies: none.

Rules: docs/prd/eligibilite-jeunes-conducteurs.md
